name: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun
summary: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Lomac Gearstrip sends volatile NG-5 to Gaxim Rustfizzle. The chemical can ignite wagons packed with dynamite, drawing enemies away while Alliance forces pursue their goals in the disputed crags.

sections.title: A Volatile Delivery
sections.body: Lomac Gearstrip gives you Nitromirglyceronium, or NG-5, an unstable compound made through gnomish engineering. He warns you to handle it with care. Mishandled, it could blow you to pieces on the road back to Gaxim Rustfizzle.

sections.title: A Recipe for Distraction
sections.body: Once Gaxim Rustfizzle receives the canister intact, he explains his plan. NG-5 can ignite entire wagons packed with dynamite. Gaxim means to cause a great explosion and sow chaos in Stonetalon, drawing enemies away while the Alliance pursues its goals in the region.

faq.answer: NG-5, short for Nitromirglyceronium, is a volatile chemical compound made by Lomac Gearstrip. It is needed to ignite heavy explosives.
Gaxim Rustfizzle is a gnome mage in the Stonetalon Mountains. He directs Alliance demolition efforts and uses explosions to distract regional threats.
Lomac Gearstrip is an engineer and associate of Gaxim Rustfizzle. He prepares the dangerous NG-5 compound and gives it to couriers.

faq.q: Why does Gaxim need so much explosive power?
faq.answer: Gaxim has arranged several wagons packed with dynamite. NG-5 can ignite them in a single blast, making a powerful diversion.

faq.q: Is the chemical dangerous to transport?
faq.answer: Yes. Lomac warns that NG-5 is unstable and could detonate if mishandled. Handle it carefully on the way to Gaxim.

faq.q: Where does this delivery take place?
faq.answer: The delivery ends at Gaxim Rustfizzle's post in the passes of the Stonetalon Mountains.

angles.text: Gnomish ambition puts Nitromirglyceronium to work igniting wagons of explosives as a distraction.
Handling NG-5 calls for care with volatile chemicals to avoid an early detonation.
Stonetalon is contested, and a massive explosion gives Alliance operatives room to pursue their goals.
